name: Coin Change (Minimum Coins)
description: Given coin denominations, find the minimum number of coins needed to make a target amount. Classic DP with optimal substructure.
aim: Find fewest coins to make amount using dp[i] = minimum coins for amount i, built bottom-up from 0 to target.
howItWorks: For each amount from 1 to target:
If c ≤ current amount and dp[amount-c]+1 < dp[amount]: update
Return dp[amount] — or -1 if no solution

time.bestCase: Always iterates over all amounts and coins

whenToUse: Coin denominations have arbitrary values (greedy fails)
Need minimum count, not just any combination
alternatives: Greedy — only works for canonical coin systems (US/EU denominations)

inputHint: The LAST number is the amount; the numbers before it are the coin denominations.
